reference: Nearest labelled nuclear pixel within 5 physical micrometres on the supplied raster; background otherwise
purpose: A deliberately distinct image-only sensitivity reference, not Proseg, a vendor segmentation reimplementation, or true ownership
labels: Source cell labels at nuclear-mask pixels, not separate nucleus IDs
coordinates: Recorded original RNA positions; lookup at their original raster pixel
exclusions: Crop-contained source cells only; transcripts within 5 micrometres of crop boundary excluded from the paired comparison to avoid unobserved external nuclei
count_scope: All eligible retained molecules; subtract excluded source records consistently from atlas count spectra
outputs: Alternative-count feasibility and minimum area per cell/gene; complete alternative owner vector compatibility tested separately
calibration: Agreement with a deterministic alternative, not probabilistic coverage or biological accuracy
mutation: No changes to atlas rules, physical constraints, gene queries, or reference labels after outputs
